title: Lightly Charred Venezuelan Goat Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring charred goat meat in a rich and creamy sauce, perfect for a hangover cure. This dish is inspired by Venezuelan cuisine and is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the goat meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned goat meat from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until lightly charred, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the browned goat meat to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the goat meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
